text: Before you speak to anyone tomorrow morning, seal your day. Do it before the world enters you. This takes ten seconds and almost nobody knows it. The first minutes after you wake are the most receptive of your whole day.
Your mind has not yet taken anything from anyone. Whatever you place there first will set the tone for everything after. So before you speak, place your hand over the centre of your body.
Feel the warmth of your own palm. And say silently: I protect my day. I protect my path. Calm, and what is mine, belong to me. I accept it.

Stay there one moment in silence. Do this three mornings in a row. The first morning seals. The second strengthens. The third activates. And keep it to yourself. What you protect in silence works with more strength.
But a gesture in the morning is not real protection. Real protection is an inner state, and it is built, not spoken. Everything I know is inside The Quiet Between Thoughts. The link is in my profile.
